title: Assess and file a patent application
summary: When a potentially patentable invention is identified before public disclosure or a filing decision. A documented protection decision and, if filed, an attorney-reviewed application receipt and prosecution calendar.
outcomes: A documented protection decision and, if filed, an attorney-reviewed application receipt and prosecution calendar.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a potentially patentable invention is identified before public disclosure or a filing decision.

parts.title: Capture the invention and disclosure history
parts.guidance: Collect inventors, technical descriptions, experiments, ownership documents and dates of actual or planned disclosures. Keep the invention confidential while patent counsel reviews the situation.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assess the protection strategy with patent counsel
parts.guidance: Counsel reviews inventorship, ownership, prior art, target markets and disclosure implications. Compare filing, trade-secret protection and publication based on the business case; patentability and freedom to operate are separate questions.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess the protection strategy with patent counsel

parts.title: Prepare the technical and commercial evidence
parts.guidance: Provide reproducible technical detail, alternatives, drawings and market priorities for counsel's drafting. Track missing information and resolve ownership or contributor questions before approving an application.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve and submit through qualified representatives
parts.guidance: The authorized applicants review the final scope, jurisdictions, costs and documents with counsel. Counsel coordinates the applicable filing route and required signatures, retaining the official receipt.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve and submit through qualified representatives

parts.title: Maintain the prosecution and disclosure calendar
parts.guidance: Record application identifiers, official correspondence and counsel-confirmed response dates. Review ongoing disclosure plans, fees and country decisions and distinguish an application from an issued patent.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A documented protection decision and, if filed, an attorney-reviewed application receipt and prosecution calendar.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
